description: What a seat's keyboard lamps show.

idle.description: The color of every key no lit row names.

flash.description: The color a flashing key starts from when its row authors no flash color of its own.

modifier.description: The color of a held chord modifier's key.

unavailableScale.description: The brightness, in [0, 1], a row's color keeps while the row is unavailable.

flashSeconds.description: The seconds a flash takes to fade back to the key's own color. Positive, at most MaxFlashSeconds.

items.description: One row of keyLights: a set of keys and the color they take. The keys are the union of what the row names three ways, each optional: Keys literally, Bound through the seat's active binding page, and Character through the key that types it.

id.description: The row's stable id, unique within the section.

color.description: The color the row's keys take.

bound.description: Binding entry ids: the keyboard sources the seat's active page binds each entry to, so the lamps follow a page change and a player's rebinding.

character.description: A Unicode scalar value, usually a state cell: the key that types it lights, and a letter lights its key whatever its case. A value no key types (zero included) lights nothing.

lit.description: The row paints while this is positive; absent, it always paints.

available.description: The row is dimmed by UnavailableScale while this is not positive; absent, it is never dimmed.

flashSignal.description: The row's keys flash each time this changes to a new value after it is first read.

flashColor.description: The color the row's flash starts from; absent, the section's Flash.

seat.description: The seat whose keyboard the row lights (seat1..seat4), or null for every local seat that holds one.

items.title: WorldKeyLightRow
